description: Every percentage question the website answers: "X% of Y" (percent_of: percent, value), "X is what % of Y" (what_percent: part, whole), percent change from A to B (change: from, to), increase/decrease a value by X% (increase/decrease: value, percent), find the original before a X% increase/decrease (reverse_increase/reverse_decrease: value, percent), and profit margin vs markup (margin_markup: cost, price). Returns the number, a display string and the worked formula. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/percentage-calc/

mode.description: Which question to answer (see the description for the fields each one uses).

part.description: what_percent: the part X in "X is what % of Y".

percent.description: The percentage X (percent_of, increase, decrease, reverse_*).

value.description: The value Y (percent_of: Y in "X% of Y"; increase/decrease: the starting value; reverse_*: the final value).

name: calc_percentage
title: Percentage calculator
